name: io.github.Servosity/huntress-mcp
title: Huntress MCP
description: Every Huntress endpoint, plus a local SQLite mirror that delivers fleet-wide incident, coverage

environmentVariables.name: PRINTING_PRESS_CLIENT_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Optional: binds the MCP server to an existing tenant-gated Printing Press client profile. Leave unset for a single-tenant install.

environmentVariables.name: HUNTRESS_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Set the HUNTRESS_API_KEY credential for the Huntress MCP server.

environmentVariables.name: HUNTRESS_API_SECRET
environmentVariables.description: Set the HUNTRESS_API_SECRET credential for the Huntress MCP server.

environmentVariables.name: HUNTRESS_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL for the Huntress API. Leave the prefilled default unless your account uses a different regional or self-hosted host.

environmentVariables.name: HUNTRESS_MCP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Set to exactly 1 to expose only read-only tools and refuse any non-GET execute call. Preset to 1; clear it only when you want the agent to run the tools this switch hides.

environmentVariables.name: HUNTRESS_NO_LOCAL_DATA
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Set to 1 to keep no local copy of API responses: reads go to the API, the response cache is off, and sync refuses to run. Leave blank to keep the local store.

environmentVariables.name: HUNTRESS_USER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends on Huntress requests.

environmentVariables.name: HUNTRESS_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http. Not needed for the default local stdio transport.
